units.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET library that creates, reads and edits PowerPoint .pptx presentations by building the Office Open XML package itself — no PowerPoint installation, no COM interop, no native dependency and no NuGet dependencies at all. It targets net8.0 and net10.0 and is implemented in the Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET and Aspose.Slides namespaces. It does not produce PDF, HTML or images, and the things it cannot do are listed in full under What it cannot do.
It creates and edits presentations, slides, and sections, supporting operations such as adding empty slides and grouping slides into named sections.
It manipulates slides by adding, removing, and reordering them, and supports section-based organization of slide groups.
It renders shapes including AutoShape, Table, Connector, and PictureFrame, with support for layout and positioning on slides.
It formats text through TextFrame, Paragraph, and Portion objects, enabling alignment, font height, bold styling, and font selection.
It applies solid fill to shapes and configures line appearance using color values specified in ARGB format.
It manages speaker notes via NotesSlideManager and adds classic comments with author, text, position, and timestamp.
It stores and retrieves metadata such as author, title, keywords, and custom fields alongside the presentation content.
It retains non-standard or proprietary elements within a presentation package when loading and saving PPTX, PPSX, or POTX files.

Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET provides the Aspose.Slides.Foss namespace with the Presentation class and supporting I* interfaces that mirror the commercial Aspose.Slides for .NET API. It targets net8.0 and net10.0 and is part of the Aspose family of products.

The Aspose.Slides.Foss namespace exposes the core Presentation class and related I* interfaces for creating, reading, and manipulating presentation files, with documentation and examples in the commercial Aspose.Slides for .NET product.

Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET reads and writes PowerPoint Open XML decks in .pptx, .ppsx, and .potx formats for .NET 8 and .NET 10, preserving the great majority of parts byte for byte when a deck is opened and saved again.
It does not render or convert decks to PDF, images, HTML, or thumbnails.
It does not support charts, SmartArt, animations, OLE objects, or macro-enabled files.
It has no API to change the slide size of a presentation.

Parts the library has no model for — presProps, viewProps, tableStyles, thumbnails, extra themes, unused layouts — are preserved unchanged when a deck is opened and saved again, but they are not modifiable.
A deck written by this library does not include language attributes on text portions, so PowerPoint applies the authoring machine's default language rather than a language the file states.
This library is not a supported commercial product and does not provide a license or technical support.
